async def _setup(pg_pool, tenant_a, tenant_b):
    async with pg_pool.acquire() as conn:
        async with conn.transaction():
            team = await conn.fetchval(
                "INSERT INTO teams (name, created_by_tenant_id) VALUES ($1, $2) RETURNING id",
                f"team-{uuid4().hex[:8]}",
                tenant_a,
            )
            await assign_role(conn, parent_team_id=team, member_kind="user", member_id=tenant_a, role_key="owner", assigned_by_user_id=tenant_a)
            await assign_role(conn, parent_team_id=team, member_kind="user", member_id=tenant_b, role_key="member", assigned_by_user_id=tenant_a)

            # map
            root_mem_id = await conn.fetchval(
                """
                INSERT INTO memories (tenant_id, team_id, content, content_hash, embedding, source_kind, type, visibility)
                VALUES ($1, $2, 'Root', $3, array_fill(0::real, ARRAY[1024])::vector, 'api', 'question', 'team')
                RETURNING id
                """,
                tenant_a, team, f"h-root-{uuid4().hex}",
            )
            child_mem_id = await conn.fetchval(
                """
                INSERT INTO memories (tenant_id, team_id, content, content_hash, embedding, source_kind, type, visibility)
                VALUES ($1, $2, 'Child', $3, array_fill(0::real, ARRAY[1024])::vector, 'api', 'note', 'team')
                RETURNING id
                """,
                tenant_a, team, f"h-child-{uuid4().hex}",
            )
            await conn.execute(
                "INSERT INTO memory_maps (root_memory_id, tenant_id, team_id, title, state) VALUES ($1,$2,$3,'m','live')",
                root_mem_id, tenant_a, team,
            )
            await conn.execute(
                "INSERT INTO memory_map_membership (memory_id, root_memory_id, tenant_id, node_role, turn, authored_by) VALUES ($1,$2,$3,'position','owner','owner')",
                child_mem_id, root_mem_id, tenant_a,
            )
            map_key = f"map-{uuid4().hex[:8]}"
            await conn.execute(
                "INSERT INTO slugs (memory_id, team_id, resource_type, slug, title) VALUES ($1,$2,'map',$3,'m')",
                root_mem_id, team, map_key,
            )
    return team, root_mem_id, child_mem_id, map_key

async def ctx(pg_pool, tenant_a, tenant_b):
    team, root, child, mk = await _setup(pg_pool, tenant_a, tenant_b)

async def _create_wf(conn, tenant_id, team_id, signoff=True):
    stages = [
        {"name": "todo", "ordinal": 0, "is_initial": True, "is_terminal": False},
        {"name": "done", "ordinal": 1, "is_initial": False, "is_terminal": True},
        {"name": "other", "ordinal": 2, "is_initial": False, "is_terminal": False},
    ]
    transitions = [
        {"from_stage": "todo", "to_stage": "done", "requires_reason": False, "requires_signoff": False},
        {"from_stage": "todo", "to_stage": "other", "requires_reason": True, "requires_signoff": signoff, "signoff_min": 1, "signoff_roles": ["member"]},
    ]
    wf = await create_team_workflow(conn, tenant_id=tenant_id, team_id=team_id, name=f"wf-{uuid4().hex[:6]}", stages=stages, transitions=transitions, created_by=tenant_id)
    await activate_workflow(conn, tenant_id=tenant_id, team_id=team_id, workflow_id=wf.workflow_id, actor_tenant_id=tenant_id)
    return wf


async def test_propose_no_signoff_commits(ctx, pg_pool):
    ta, tb, team, root, child, mk = ctx["tenant_a"], ctx["tenant_b"], ctx["team"], ctx["root"], ctx["child"], ctx["map_key"]
    async with tenant_tx(pg_pool, ta) as conn:
        await _create_wf(conn, ta, team, signoff=False)
        await materialise_legacy_workflow(conn, tenant_id=ta, team_id=team)
    async with tenant_tx(pg_pool, ta) as conn:
        await work_items.mark_work_item(conn, tenant_id=ta, team_id=team, map_key=mk, node_id=child, kind="story")
    async with tenant_tx(pg_pool, ta) as conn:
        res = await workflow_moves.propose_move(conn, tenant_id=ta, team_id=team, map_key=mk, node_id=child, to_stage="done", proposer_tenant_id=ta)
        assert not isinstance(res, workflow_moves.WorkflowSignoffRequest) if hasattr(workflow_moves, "WorkflowSignoffRequest") else True
    # assert db state
    async with pg_pool.acquire() as conn:
        async with conn.transaction():
            stage = await conn.fetchval("SELECT current_stage FROM work_items WHERE memory_id=$1", child)
            assert stage == "done"
            hist = await conn.fetch("SELECT event_type, stage_before, stage_after, workflow_id FROM work_item_history WHERE memory_id=$1", child)
            assert any(h["event_type"] == "stage" and h["stage_before"] == "todo" and h["stage_after"] == "done" and h["workflow_id"] is not None for h in hist)


async def test_propose_signoff_gated_pending(ctx, pg_pool):
    ta, tb, team, root, child, mk = ctx["tenant_a"], ctx["tenant_b"], ctx["team"], ctx["root"], ctx["child"], ctx["map_key"]
    async with tenant_tx(pg_pool, ta) as conn:
        await _create_wf(conn, ta, team, signoff=True)
    async with tenant_tx(pg_pool, ta) as conn:
        await work_items.mark_work_item(conn, tenant_id=ta, team_id=team, map_key=mk, node_id=child, kind="story")
    async with tenant_tx(pg_pool, ta) as conn:
        res = await workflow_moves.propose_move(conn, tenant_id=ta, team_id=team, map_key=mk, node_id=child, to_stage="other", proposer_tenant_id=ta)
        assert isinstance(res, workflow_moves.WorkflowSignoffRequest)
        assert res.status == "pending"
        # current_stage unchanged
    async with pg_pool.acquire() as conn:
        async with conn.transaction():
            stage = await conn.fetchval("SELECT current_stage FROM work_items WHERE memory_id=$1", child)
            assert stage == "todo"
            req = await conn.fetchrow("SELECT status FROM workflow_signoff_requests WHERE work_item_memory_id=$1", child)
            assert req["status"] == "pending"
            hist = await conn.fetch("SELECT event_type FROM work_item_history WHERE memory_id=$1", child)
            assert any(h["event_type"] == "signoff_requested" for h in hist)


async def test_sign_commits_at_min(ctx, pg_pool):
    ta, tb, team, root, child, mk = ctx["tenant_a"], ctx["tenant_b"], ctx["team"], ctx["root"], ctx["child"], ctx["map_key"]
    async with tenant_tx(pg_pool, ta) as conn:
        await _create_wf(conn, ta, team, signoff=True)
    async with tenant_tx(pg_pool, ta) as conn:
        await work_items.mark_work_item(conn, tenant_id=ta, team_id=team, map_key=mk, node_id=child, kind="story")
    req_id = None
    async with tenant_tx(pg_pool, ta) as conn:
        res = await workflow_moves.propose_move(conn, tenant_id=ta, team_id=team, map_key=mk, node_id=child, to_stage="other", proposer_tenant_id=ta)
        req_id = res.request_id
    # sign by eligible member tenant_b
    async with tenant_tx(pg_pool, tb) as conn:
        out = await workflow_moves.sign_workflow_move(conn, tenant_id=ta, team_id=team, request_id=req_id, signatory_tenant_id=tb)
        assert out is not None
    async with pg_pool.acquire() as conn:
        async with conn.transaction():
            stage = await conn.fetchval("SELECT current_stage FROM work_items WHERE memory_id=$1", child)
            assert stage == "other"
            req = await conn.fetchrow("SELECT status FROM workflow_signoff_requests WHERE request_id=$1", req_id)
            assert req["status"] == "committed"
            hist = await conn.fetch("SELECT event_type FROM work_item_history WHERE memory_id=$1", child)
            assert any(h["event_type"] == "stage" for h in hist)
            assert any(h["event_type"] == "signoff_approved" for h in hist)


async def test_owner_sign_does_not_count(ctx, pg_pool):
    ta, tb, team, root, child, mk = ctx["tenant_a"], ctx["tenant_b"], ctx["team"], ctx["root"], ctx["child"], ctx["map_key"]
    async with tenant_tx(pg_pool, ta) as conn:
        await _create_wf(conn, ta, team, signoff=True)
    async with tenant_tx(pg_pool, ta) as conn:
        await work_items.mark_work_item(conn, tenant_id=ta, team_id=team, map_key=mk, node_id=child, kind="story")
    req_id = None
    async with tenant_tx(pg_pool, ta) as conn:
        res = await workflow_moves.propose_move(conn, tenant_id=ta, team_id=team, map_key=mk, node_id=child, to_stage="other", proposer_tenant_id=ta)
        req_id = res.request_id
    with pytest.raises(SignoffNotAllowedError):
        async with tenant_tx(pg_pool, ta) as conn:
            await workflow_moves.sign_workflow_move(conn, tenant_id=ta, team_id=team, request_id=req_id, signatory_tenant_id=ta)
    async with pg_pool.acquire() as conn:
        async with conn.transaction():
            stage = await conn.fetchval("SELECT current_stage FROM work_items WHERE memory_id=$1", child)
            assert stage == "todo"
            req = await conn.fetchrow("SELECT status FROM workflow_signoff_requests WHERE request_id=$1", req_id)
            assert req["status"] == "pending"


async def test_cancel_permissions(ctx, pg_pool):
    ta, tb, team, root, child, mk = ctx["tenant_a"], ctx["tenant_b"], ctx["team"], ctx["root"], ctx["child"], ctx["map_key"]
    async with tenant_tx(pg_pool, ta) as conn:
        await _create_wf(conn, ta, team, signoff=True)
    async with tenant_tx(pg_pool, ta) as conn:
        await work_items.mark_work_item(conn, tenant_id=ta, team_id=team, map_key=mk, node_id=child, kind="story")
    req_id = None
    async with tenant_tx(pg_pool, ta) as conn:
        res = await workflow_moves.propose_move(conn, tenant_id=ta, team_id=team, map_key=mk, node_id=child, to_stage="other", proposer_tenant_id=ta)
        req_id = res.request_id
    # non-proposer non-admin member cannot cancel
    with pytest.raises(WorkflowPermissionDeniedError):
        async with tenant_tx(pg_pool, tb) as conn:
            await workflow_moves.cancel_workflow_move(conn, tenant_id=ta, team_id=team, request_id=req_id, actor_tenant_id=tb)
    # proposer can
    async with tenant_tx(pg_pool, ta) as conn:
        await workflow_moves.cancel_workflow_move(conn, tenant_id=ta, team_id=team, request_id=req_id, actor_tenant_id=ta)
    async with pg_pool.acquire() as conn:
        async with conn.transaction():
            req = await conn.fetchrow("SELECT status FROM workflow_signoff_requests WHERE request_id=$1", req_id)
            assert req["status"] == "cancelled"


async def test_compute_item_moves(ctx, pg_pool):
    ta, tb, team, root, child, mk = ctx["tenant_a"], ctx["tenant_b"], ctx["team"], ctx["root"], ctx["child"], ctx["map_key"]
    async with tenant_tx(pg_pool, ta) as conn:
        await _create_wf(conn, ta, team, signoff=True)
    async with tenant_tx(pg_pool, ta) as conn:
        await work_items.mark_work_item(conn, tenant_id=ta, team_id=team, map_key=mk, node_id=child, kind="story")
    async with tenant_tx(pg_pool, ta) as conn:
        moves = await workflow_reads.compute_item_moves(conn, tenant_id=ta, team_id=team, map_key=mk, node_id=child, viewing_tenant_id=ta)
        assert isinstance(moves, list)
        reasons = {m.blocked_reason for m in moves}
        for m in moves:
            assert m.blocked_reason in {None, "reason_required", "no_transition", "role_restricted"} or (isinstance(m.blocked_reason, str) and m.blocked_reason.startswith("awaiting "))
            # fields
            assert hasattr(m, "signoff_min")
            assert hasattr(m, "signatory_count")
            assert hasattr(m, "remaining")
            assert hasattr(m, "eligible_to_sign")
        # signoff transition to other should be awaiting
        other = [m for m in moves if m.to_stage == "other"][0]
        assert other.blocked_reason == "awaiting 1 sign-offs"
        assert other.signoff_min == 1
        assert other.remaining == 1


async def test_compute_item_moves_unmapped(ctx, pg_pool):
    ta, tb, team, root, child, mk = ctx["tenant_a"], ctx["tenant_b"], ctx["team"], ctx["root"], ctx["child"], ctx["map_key"]
    async with tenant_tx(pg_pool, ta) as conn:
        await _create_wf(conn, ta, team, signoff=True)
    async with tenant_tx(pg_pool, ta) as conn:
        await work_items.mark_work_item(conn, tenant_id=ta, team_id=team, map_key=mk, node_id=child, kind="story")
    # set current_stage to unmapped
    async with pg_pool.acquire() as conn:
        async with conn.transaction():
            await conn.execute("UPDATE work_items SET current_stage='bogus' WHERE memory_id=$1", child)
    async with tenant_tx(pg_pool, ta) as conn:
        moves = await workflow_reads.compute_item_moves(conn, tenant_id=ta, team_id=team, map_key=mk, node_id=child, viewing_tenant_id=ta)
        assert all(m.blocked_reason == "no_transition" for m in moves)
        assert all(m.transition_id is None for m in moves)


async def test_list_pending_signoffs(ctx, pg_pool):
    ta, tb, team, root, child, mk = ctx["tenant_a"], ctx["tenant_b"], ctx["team"], ctx["root"], ctx["child"], ctx["map_key"]
    async with tenant_tx(pg_pool, ta) as conn:
        await _create_wf(conn, ta, team, signoff=True)
    async with tenant_tx(pg_pool, ta) as conn:
        await work_items.mark_work_item(conn, tenant_id=ta, team_id=team, map_key=mk, node_id=child, kind="story")
    async with tenant_tx(pg_pool, ta) as conn:
        res = await workflow_moves.propose_move(conn, tenant_id=ta, team_id=team, map_key=mk, node_id=child, to_stage="other", proposer_tenant_id=ta)
    # eligible member sees it
    async with tenant_tx(pg_pool, tb) as conn:
        lst = await workflow_reads.list_pending_signoffs_for_user(conn, tenant_id=ta, team_id=team, signatory_tenant_id=tb)
        assert len(lst) == 1
        ps = lst[0]
        assert ps.from_stage == "todo"
        assert ps.to_stage == "other"
        assert ps.signoff_min == 1
        assert ps.signatory_count == 0
        assert ps.remaining == 1
    # owner/proposer does not
    async with tenant_tx(pg_pool, ta) as conn:
        lst2 = await workflow_reads.list_pending_signoffs_for_user(conn, tenant_id=ta, team_id=team, signatory_tenant_id=ta)
        assert lst2 == []

async def test_signoff_required_type():
    # DB-free: ensure the exception type exists and is a WorkflowError subclass
    assert issubclass(SignoffRequiredError, Exception)
    assert SignoffRequiredError.__name__ == "SignoffRequiredError"
